amendments.change: Predeclared 2% congestion and 20 ps WNS guards for the secondary non-regression gate.

Apply the same ORFS resource/convergence adaptation to candidate and control: SKIP_CTS_REPAIR_TIMING=1 because CTS repair exceeded available memory, and droute_end_iter=10 because the frozen end_iter=1 sensitivity run left 49712 DRC.

scope: External macro-placement to routed-PPA validation; not part of the FloorSet official benchmark

preferred.name: OpenROAD-flow-scripts
preferred.license: BSD-3-Clause for flow scripts; each design, platform and tool retains its own license
preferred.use: official designs, synthesis seed, complete physical-design flow and METRICS_2.1.2 extraction

optional_benchmark_cache.name: FlowPlace OpenROAD benchmark cache
optional_benchmark_cache.use: allowed only after local license/provenance audit; otherwise do not use or redistribute

optional_evaluator.name: FlowPlace openroad_ppa_evaluator.py
optional_evaluator.use: audit before copying; ORFS genMetrics is the primary fallback

optional_global_placer.name: DREAMPlace
optional_global_placer.use: only if the selected ORFS design requires a separate mixed-size handoff

required_inputs: successful baseline synthesis and floorplan dry run
eligibility: at least one macro with nonzero b2b or p2b connectivity
baseline global route and detailed route terminate within the predeclared timeout
all macro dimensions and orientations map one-to-one to DEF
no missing clock, PDK or routing-layer input
deterministic_ranking: partition eligible cases into small (1-40 macros), medium (41-80) and large (81-120)
take the lexicographically first eligible case from each nonempty stratum
fill remaining slots by ascending macro count, then case name
extend the large-case cap to 160 only if fewer than three eligible cases exist
never select or replace a case based on candidate PPA
case_selection.fallback_if_fewer_than_three: Reject external PPA promotion and report the missing supported cases; do not substitute FloorSet or Bookshelf surrogate metrics.

arms.control: graph-token EMA checkpoints with the same macro legalizer and DEF adapter
arms.external_anchor: released FlowPlace DEF if legally usable, otherwise the strongest licensed published DEF available
arms.model_selection: Use all three fixed seeds for the final external claim; a one-seed screen is diagnostic only.

same_infrastructure.platform: identical for all arms and cases
same_infrastructure.macro_legalizer: same implementation and iterations for candidate and control
same_infrastructure.def_writer: same implementation for candidate and control

primary.aggregation: mean of per-case candidate/control ratios across the frozen cases and fixed seeds

regression_guards.timing_claims: WNS/TNS and violating-endpoint counts report all cases; no cherry-picked endpoint

metrics.na_policy: A primary metric marked N/A rejects promotion rather than falling back to a surrogate.

statistics.primary_estimand: fixed-seed mean relative routed wirelength over frozen cases
forbidden: i.i.d. bootstrap over repeated cases across seeds
claiming statistical significance from fewer than ten independent designs

required: candidate and control complete the same routed flow
primary routed wirelength improves at least 2%
legality and DRC do not regress
power and std-cell area stay within the guarded threshold
at least one of congestion or timing is directionally consistent or explicitly neutral
promotion_gate.failure_decision: Retain the FloorSet bounded-mechanism study and recommend DAC/ICCAD/ISPD/DATE instead of claiming CVPR placement/PPA improvement.
